description: This Java class 'ResultActivity' is an Android activity that displays a message received from an intent, and provides UI controls for snoozing or dismissing a notification, by calling methods that start a service with specific actions.

classes.name: ResultActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that shows a message from the intent and provides options to snooze or dismiss a notification.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and displays the message received via intent.

methods.name: onSnoozeClick
methods.description: Handles snooze button click, starts the 'PingService' with the snooze action.

methods.name: onDismissClick
methods.description: Handles dismiss button click, starts the 'PingService' with the dismiss action.
